name: tb2j
description: Check Wannier90 Hamiltonian files and run TB2J's wann2J.py for exchange post-processing.

required: input_dir containing POSCAR and the selected Wannier90 Hamiltonian files

configuration.prefix: spinor prefix; collinear uses prefix_up and prefix_down
configuration.win: optional prefix.win; only num_wann and spinors are checked
configuration.output_dir: local output directory, default TB2J_results under input_dir

artifacts: tb2j_run.json containing argv, cwd, stdout, stderr, returncode, and exchange.out status
output_contract.stdout: doctor, check, and run print one JSON object
output_contract.success: run succeeds only when wann2J.py returns zero and output_dir/exchange.out is non-empty
output_contract.interpretation: The extension does not decide the sign or physical meaning of J/DMI values.

executables: wann2J.py supplied by the user or site environment

authorization_policy.notes: Only caller-selected local input/output paths are used; no SSH, scheduler, or remote operation is performed.

source_provenance.notes: The wrapper delegates to the user-provided TB2J executable. Official parameter names are recorded in README.md and are not copied from the manual.
